trial: One candidate: remove only the per-known-character lower feature floor of -6 in the trigram and fourgram scorer. Preserve insertion prior +6, upper guard, finite-value guard, OOV -4, LM .5, dictionary weights, personal-word backoff, correction calibration and search budgets.
hypotheses: Clipping unequal rare emissions can collapse log odds and prevent common backoff offsets from cancelling; a synthetic score-level regression must fail before the change and pass afterward.
Retaining low-probability evidence may reduce nonsensical homophone combinations; it may also hurt valid rare words, so actual candidate regressions decide adoption.
User-new-word backoff, OOV handling, completion insertion-prior removal and no-LM paths must retain their existing protection.

development.gate: Each domain top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly increases. These are known regressions, not new blind accuracy.

stopRule: If development fails, retain every output and the candidate patch, restore the original scorer, and do not sweep new floors/weights or open further accuracy data for this candidate.
laterGates: Only after development pass: whole known-test and typo regression, short/progressive/personal controls, service/UI tests and one fixed Android timing comparison. No production release before those gates.
diagnosticOnly: The known E28 lei examples are observed but not a separate promotion gate; no word-specific scoring.
